admission_criteria.note: Initial thresholds for WP-EDGE-01, recorded before the campaign ran. They are NOT an approved profitability bar; they are the minimum evidence needed to avoid calling noise an edge. The cost-stress criterion (OOS net still positive at 2x fees) is stated here rather than inferred from the measured results.
